name: KokobeoChat
author: Omar Soligo

sections.description:
KokobeoChat is the easiest way to add live chat and AI support to your WordPress site.

Connect with your visitors in real time, automate responses with AI, and never miss a customer message.

  • Free plan no credit card required
  • Real-time live chat
  • AI-powered automatic replies
  • 14 languages supported
  • Mobile-friendly widget
  • Multiple operators
  • GDPR compliant

External Services

This plugin connects to the KokobeoChat service (chat.kokobeo.com) to load the live chat widget. When a page with the widget is loaded, the visitor browser connects to chat.kokobeo.com to render the chat interface. Chat messages are transmitted to KokobeoChat servers to enable real-time support.

Service: chat.kokobeo.com
Data sent: chat messages, visitor IP, browser language
Terms of Service: https://chat.kokobeo.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://chat.kokobeo.com/privacy.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/kokobeo-chat/
  2. Activate via the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > KokobeoChat
  4. Enter your API key from chat.kokobeo.com
  5. Save the chat widget appears automatically
sections.faq:
Where do I get my API key?

Sign up at chat.kokobeo.com your API key is generated instantly after registration.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. See our privacy policy at https://chat.kokobeo.com/privacy.html
